author: Zeusy
body:
In "One in The Chamber" you get a wooden or gold axe (both do the same damage) It takes about 10 hits to kill a guy. So if you miss your arrow, your done.

I think it'll be much better if we get a Stone Sword with Unbreaking.

Feedback? ;)
